intent: Second-stage composition: Rotate a supported BMP image 90 degrees clockwise and expose its RGB raster
limitations: Inputs satisfy the composition schema. No unsupported composition inputs are scored.
instructions: Implement transform(input:string,lib)->string. Parse {version:1,images:[base64BMP,...],background:"rrggbb"}; 1..4 supported BMPs, six lowercase background hex digits. Call retained lib["a5-01"](Buffer.from(image,"base64")) to obtain each clockwise rotated raster. Lay them left-to-right in input order, top aligned, with no gap. Pad under each shorter image with the background color. Return {width:sumOfRotatedWidths,height:maxRotatedHeight,rgb:rowMajorLowercaseRGBHex}. The heldout suite measures output and separately records actual retained-call counts; full composition-reuse credit requires >=1 call for every input image.
